hero.filename: Mortmar, North Shore, California and Salton Sea, Santa Rosa Mountains.jpg
hero.caption: Mortmar, North Shore, California and Salton Sea, Santa Rosa Mountains. This image was captured in the Imperial/Lower Coachella Valleys EPA Level IV Ecoregion and faces the Santa Rosa Mountains which contain the Upper Coachella Valley and Hills EPA Level IV Ecoregion (81e) seen at the foothill level, the Western Sonoran Mountains EPA Level IV Ecoregion (81a), and Western Sonoran Mountain Woodland and Shrubland EPA Level IV Ecoregion (81b). The Western Sonoran Basins Level IV Ecoregion (81c) can be seen on left of the Santa Rosa Mountains. In One Earth's ecoregion framework, this image captures the Sonoran Desert Ecoregion.

images.filename: A-4F of VF-126 and F-14A of VF-111 dogfighting 1982.jpg
images.caption: A U.S. Navy Douglas A-4F Skyhawk of Fighter Squadron VF-126 "Bandits" engages a Grumman F-14A Tomcat of VF-111 "Sundowners" in air combat maneuvering over the Salton Sea, in 1982.
